notes: §1985:XI.4.1.3 SR1: 'A MERGE statement may appear anywhere in the Procedure Division except in the declaratives portion.' SortBinder.ScreenDeclarativePlacement refuses a MERGE when EnclosingContext.InDeclarative, which BinderContext.DeclarativeAtCursor answers from the BoundDeclarative table; VersionConformancePass.GateSortMergeProcedures gates the 2023-only MERGE-in-SORT/MERGE-procedure ban to Year >= 2023, so at 85 a MERGE in another MERGE's output procedure compiles, as the 1985 'anywhere' wording allows (probe M2C: AAAA DONE at 85, COBOL1572 at 2023). The hole: ProcedureTableBuilder.DeclCollectSection collects a USE FOR DEBUGGING section (WITH DEBUGGING MODE) as an ordinary pc range and never adds a BoundDeclarative, so DeclarativeAtCursor answers null inside it, and a MERGE written in a debugging section, which §1985:XV.3.2.3 SR1 places in the declaratives ('Debugging section(s), if specified, must appear together immediately after the DECLARATIVES header'), compiles and executes. Probes at --std 85: (b) MERGE in a USE AFTER ERROR section, nested two IFs deep in its second paragraph: COBOL2700 (M2D), the witness's case; MERGE in a main-line paragraph PERFORMed from a declarative: compiles and runs AAAA BBBB CCCC (M2A, legal, the rule is lexical); MERGE in a debugging declarative: no diagnostic, executed (M2B, M2E); (c) MERGE in another MERGE's output procedure: accepted at 85, refused at 2023 (M2C); (e) sequential USING/GIVING files merged in key order. Classes a, d and f do not reach a placement rule. The witness exercises the USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR arm. kb/Work PB5275 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-47.json).

next.reason: 1985: "may appear anywhere in the Procedure Division except in the declaratives portion"; 2023: "except in imperative-statement-1 of an exception-checking PERFORM statement, or in an output procedure of another MERGE statement". 2023 keeps the declaratives ban but adds bans: exception-checking PERFORM, another MERGE's output procedure, and file SORT input/output procedures. The 1985 rule states only declaratives.
